title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia, Island]
description: Secluded from the emporia by reed canary grass at the edge of a wide pond, a small island garden forms a quiet oasis.  Centered within it, an alabaster marble fountain is encircled by four stone benches, while broad patches of wildflowers lend vibrancy throughout the space.  A circular building wrought from exposed timber beams and irregular stones rises just beyond the garden's heart, its solid construction marking a functional presence among the serene surroundings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
